# Frozen production campaign (paper dataset) — 2026-07-27

The canonical dataset for the methods paper (docs/paper_plan.md). One simulation
volume (seed 12345), eight observer corners = full sky.

**Frozen configuration** (per octant, `config_prod_octZYX.toml`, generated by
`generate_configs.py` and committed):
- N=6144, box = 5236 Mpc/h (= 7700 Mpc), cellsize 0.85221 Mpc/h (matches Websky)
- ntile=16, n=414, nbuff=16; **coarse_factor=32** (velocity coherence);
  **z_max=4.5** (matches released Websky late-time maps); 2LPT; ioutshear=1
- Cosmology Om=0.31, OB=0.049, OL=0.69, h=0.68; finecell filter bank
- Octant bits octZYX: bit=1 → observer at +2618 Mpc/h on that axis, 0 → −2618

**Products** per octant:
- `catalog_websky_6144_prod_octZYX.pksc` (raw) and `_AM.pksc` (abundance-matched;
  Tinker, per-axis observer, z_max=4.5) in
  `/home/yguan/projects/aip-aspuru-ab/yguan/websky/`
- Field maps (kappa/mass/tau/ksz/isw, Nside 4096, full matter, no exclusion) in
  `/home/yguan/scratch/websky_6144/fieldmaps_prod/` — **move to /project when
  complete; scratch is purged**

**Jobs**: `bash submit_all.sh` → per octant one catalog+AM job (b2, 4×L40S,
≤10 h; anchor 7h13m) + one independent fieldmap job (b1, 1×L40S, ≤2h55; anchor
~1.3 h). Composite map assembly (halo painting + field + tails) happens
after, per the TIER_B_SUMMARY recipes.

Downstream (not in these jobs): per-octant composite κ/kSZ maps, tSZ/CIB halo
maps, map gallery, benchmarks (paper_plan.md §3).
